verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm pages are written in Markdown (fern-docs-22), and page sources can be fetched as `.md` or `.mdx` (fern-docs-6), which implies MDX authoring. Fern's MCP server can look up 'components' (fern-docs-5), so a component library exists, but none of the story's specific components is documented. Missing for 10: documented tabs, callouts, code groups and steps components; evidence that rich layouts need no custom HTML; independent or hands-on corroboration of the authoring experience.
